_comment: Four REAL CNAIR notifications received by ops (Outlook .msg exports, read 2026-10-03), reduced to their non-personal facts. Crew lines are marked filled/empty (initials never written); addresses are not kept (sender is an address at cnair.es; the cancellation's display name is the registration). The .msg files themselves are not in the repo. The MIME shape Zimbra sends over SMTP is NOT in these files: see README.
mailer: Zimbra (Message-IDs @JavaMail.zimbra@cnair.es); received by Clearway's Exchange via Hornetsecurity; SPF, DKIM and DMARC pass for cnair.es
mime: Content-Type: multipart/alternative; boundary="----=_Part_<n>_<n>.<ms>" (the text/calendar part is one of the alternatives; its exact layout is unverified)

messages.subject: Cancelado: LEBL-GMAZ-GMMZ-LEBL
messages.textBody: La siguiente reunión ha sido cancelada:
messages.blockWhere: the appointment description only (two leading spaces, every line padded with trailing spaces); NOT in the text body

observations: The UID is a plain UUID per flight, carried in the .msg's GlobalObjectId as "vCal-Uid" (an Outlook-converted third-party UID), i.e. Zimbra's iCalendar UID.
The crew keys are #1º: and #2º: (with the ordinal), not #1: / #2:.
#Pax is one count per leg in leg order (0/5/5 on the three-leg trip); #ETD is one HH:MM:SS-ICAO per leg in the same order.

The appointment's start is the first ETD read as Europe/Madrid local time; its end does not follow any one rule (the last ETD taken as UTC in two cases, 20:51Z in another). Calendar times are never used for the flight.
No SEQUENCE is visible in a .msg; whether Zimbra sends updates with the same UID and a higher SEQUENCE is still unknown (no real update has been seen).

2026-10-08, the first real message through Resend (LEBL-LPFR-LEBL, #Ref 2610228, uid 6b65d09f-e212-4884-985d-707dea56b4e2, IPM.Schedule.Meeting.Request, crew lines #1º and #2º filled, #TCP empty, #Pax 0/4, #ETD 17:45:00-LEBL 19:00:00-LPFR, #DATE 17/10/26, #Cliente (Intracomunitario Pasaje)). It arrived as an Outlook FORWARD of the appointment: the text part had each key alone on a line with its value two lines below (the HTML part is a table), the Where: line carried the keys run together and cut short at #Otros, and the calendar LOCATION carried the provider's padded copy. The º arrived as U+FFFD. The .msg export's body has a third layout (a run of spaces after each colon). Fixtures: forward-2610228.eml (redacted delivered copy), invite-request-2610228.eml.
